newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks mixed on MSCI index news.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks mixed on MSCI index news.

text.p: Jakarta stocks were down but off earlier lows by midsession on Thursday following an announcement on the composition of the new Morgan Stanley Capital Index (MSCI), brokers said.

At the break, the Jakarta Composite Index was off 0.93 points, or 0.14 percent, to 651.12 points, slightly recovering after falling to 648.00 points. Gainers led losers by 49 to 44, with 58 counters unchanged.
Brokers said trading was likely to continue being mixed in the afternoon session as some investors were likely to reshuffle their funds in accordance with the new index.

Morgan Stanley said in an announcement that it was adding Apac Centertex Corp, Asahimas Flat Glass, Bank Negara Indonesia, Bimantara Citra, Citra Marga Nusaphala, Daya Guna Samudera, Fiskaragung Perkasa, Indofood Sukses Makmur, Semen Gresik, Sierad Produce and Tambang Timah to its index.
It also said some stocks were deleted from the index such as Semen Cibinong.
MSCI also said it will change Gudang Garam's market capitalisation factor from 1.0 to 0.4.
Blue chip Bank Negara Indonesia was the most active stock with about 48 million shares traded, rising 175 rupiah to 1,525 rupiah following its inclusion on the MSCI.
Cigarette company Gudang Garam plunged 8.09 percent to 9,375 rupiah after MSCI said it will change its market capitalisation factor, brokers said.
